text: Your decision, your responsibility, your future. Plan: values, dream, skills, steps for this year. You are building your man/woman (son/daughter).

review_defects.why: The English adds an explanatory gloss '(son/daughter)' that is not present in the Arabic. The Arabic literally says 'your man/your woman', which is a common expression for the adult the child will become, but the parenthetical addition is an interpretation not found in the source.
